surfaces.name: Dungeon map authoring
surfaces.notes: Maps are persisted under data/maps, authored in Thestra Studio, previewed through the real engine, and guarded by map/editor validation plus visual gates.

surfaces.name: Party formation
surfaces.notes: Formation state exists at runtime and round-trips through game state, but no first-class Studio authoring/preview closure is claimed yet.

surfaces.name: Actor database
surfaces.notes: Unit records are schema-driven and authorable in the Database editor; a dedicated live actor presentation preview is not yet part of the authoring surface.

surfaces.name: Monster database
surfaces.notes: Monster/unit records are schema-driven and authorable in the Database editor; a dedicated live monster presentation preview remains unclaimed.

surfaces.name: Item database
surfaces.notes: Items are persisted and schema-authored in the Database editor. Runtime visual preview is not required for this data-only surface; editor/gate coverage is the relevant closure.

surfaces.name: Encounter and troop authoring
surfaces.notes: Troops and map encounter cadence are persisted and authorable, with dedicated boundary tests; the Studio does not yet claim one live encounter simulation preview surface.

surfaces.name: Scene world camera policy
surfaces.notes: #617 landed Scene.worldPresentation.camera runtime/persistence and shared camera resolution, but did not establish first-class Studio fields or new canonical G5/G6 references for the overhead profiles.

surfaces.name: Design-pixel density
surfaces.notes: #617 landed Scene.worldPresentation.pixelsPerTile plus conversion helpers. Dedicated Studio authoring, live authored-scale actor preview, and canonical visual/parity coverage are not yet claimed.

surfaces.name: Authored Wall Top visual role
surfaces.notes: #617 landed the Wall Top runtime role, tileset resolution, compatibility fallback, and live overhead viewport visibility; Studio authoring and canonical parity/golden closure remain explicit debt.

surfaces.name: Map vertex lighting
surfaces.notes: Vertex shading is a first-class Map Inspector authoring surface with live map presentation; this census does not yet claim a dedicated canonical fixture or editor/runtime parity contract for the authored values.

surfaces.name: Map and common event command authoring
surfaces.notes: Map Events and Common Events share the registry-driven command editor; persisted command trees are validated against engine command contexts and exercised through existing editor/runtime gates.

surfaces.name: Skills, passives, states, elements and roles
surfaces.notes: These gameplay definitions are persisted and schema-authored in the Database editor; a unified live gameplay preview for the family is not yet claimed.

surfaces.name: Animation authoring
surfaces.notes: Animations have a dedicated Studio editor and live preview. This seed deliberately leaves explicit parity and additional hardening claims open rather than inferring them from visual coverage.

surfaces.name: Flows and Scene hooks
surfaces.notes: Flows and Scene command lists use the shared event-command language and persist as authored data; a single first-class live authoring preview for the whole family is not yet claimed.
